src: (row cite: SerializeParams writes reload under aim_range)
manual: no fixture (needs a vanilla ability that uses ability_weapon: pick one in set/ with an aim_range key, copy to a mod with clone-entity --stuff and change aim_range only). In game use the ability twice: the cooldown/reload between uses follows the changed aim_range value, not a `reload` key. Needs eyes + stopwatch; not scriptable via the pipe (no ability trigger command).
